+from rich.markup import escape, render
+from rich.text import Text
+
+def test_escape_trailing_backslash():
+    # Case 1: Single trailing backslash
+    s1 = "test\\"
+    escaped1 = escape(s1)
+    print(f"Input: {s1!r}, Escaped: {escaped1!r}")
+    rendered1 = render(escaped1)
+    print(f"Rendered plain: {rendered1.plain!r}")
+
+    # Case 2: Double trailing backslash
+    s2 = "test\\\\"
+    escaped2 = escape(s2)
+    print(f"Input: {s2!r}, Escaped: {escaped2!r}")
+    rendered2 = render(escaped2)
+    print(f"Rendered plain: {rendered2.plain!r}")
+
+    # Case 3: Backslash before a tag
+    s3 = "test\\[bold]"
+    escaped3 = escape(s3)
+    print(f"Input: {s3!r}, Escaped: {escaped3!r}")
+    rendered3 = render(escaped3)
+    print(f"Rendered plain: {rendered3.plain!r}")
+
+    # Case 4: Backslash before a bracket
+    s4 = "test\\["
+    escaped4 = escape(s4)
+    print(f"Input: {s4!r}, Escaped: {escaped4!r}")
+    rendered4 = render(escaped4)
+    print(f"Rendered plain: {rendered4.plain!r}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_escape_trailing_backslash()
